title: Hal active exit rules (read by the mini hal-exit-watch)
description: Hal writes this file on the box at paper-trades/hal-live/active-exit-rules.json at EVERY entry and exit (atomic write, whole file). The box mirror poller pushes it to the mini (POST /v1/desk-state) within ~15 s in market hours (60 s otherwise). The watcher re-reads it on every 3 s check. A seat that is not in the file is not watched. Hal's seed {owner, account, updated_at, seats: []} is valid. Unknown fields are ignored. Prices are per-share option prices (not x100).

account.description: Default account for seats that omit it

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 with offset; set on every write

seat_id.description: Stable id; de-dupe state is keyed on seat_id + rule

status.description: Only open/active seats are watched (or just remove the seat)

occ_symbol.description: OCC symbol of a single-leg option, e.g. AMD261023C00540000. Added to the mini OPRA subscription automatically.

legs.description: Multi-leg alternative to occ_symbol. Seat mark = sum(ratio x leg mid); seat bid = long legs at bid, short legs at ask.

entry_px.description: Fill price per share (option) - base for take_half

option_stop.description: Trips when option MID <= this. Bid is reported too.

stock_stop.description: Trips when stock LAST is through this level

stock_stop_dir.description: below = trip when last <= stock_stop (calls); above = last >= stock_stop (puts). Default from side.

target_stock.description: Trips when stock last reaches this on the profit side (opposite of stock_stop_dir)

dir.description: below = trip when a 5-min bar CLOSES under level

take_half_pct.description: Trips when mid >= entry_px x (1 + pct/100)

half_taken.description: Set true after the half is sold to silence take_half

time_stop_pt.description: PT wall-clock HH:MM (24 h) at which the seat must be reviewed/closed

dte.description: Days to expiry; computed from occ_symbol when omitted. <= 8 gets the 12:40 PT pre-close warning.
